description: This file defines a class 'ClaroFormHooks' that implements form alter hooks for the Drupal 'claro' theme, customizing form behaviors such as delete links and views form modifications.

classes.name: ClaroFormHooks
classes.description: A class providing hook implementations for form alterations in the Drupal 'claro' theme.

methods.name: formAlter
methods.description: Implements hook_form_alter() to modify forms, including delete links and views forms, based on form object type and context.
